summary: Clean layering (api -> service -> repository), contract-first, and every acceptance criterion has tests. One missed scenario is fixed below (cached redirect after delete); two follow-ups are recorded for the next iteration.

coverage.evidence: contract check passed: 6 operations match api/openapi.yaml

findings.message: Delete invalidates the cache, but no HTTP-level test proves a link that was already redirected (so cached) stops redirecting after delete.
findings.suggestion: Add an integration test: redirect, delete, redirect -> 404 (added in fixes).

findings.message: POST /api/v1/links has no rate limit; scripted abuse can fill the table.
findings.suggestion: Follow-up: enforce at the API gateway (documented as out of scope) or add a token bucket per client IP.

findings.message: Stats aggregate raw click_events on every request; fine at v1 volume but O(clicks) per call.
findings.suggestion: Follow-up: daily rollup table fed by the analytics queue (docs/scalability.md step 4).

missed_scenarios: Concurrent creates with the same custom alias: covered by the unique constraint (one 201, one 409); no concurrency test yet.
Very high click volume on one link: covered by the atomic counter; not load tested here.
